items.what: Name and email of people who sign up for an event, join a waitlist, volunteer, or apply as a vendor or presenter, plus their phone number and business name when they gave one, with tags for what they did, the event and its region
items.where: The FluentCRM contact list in this website's database
items.when: only when FluentCRM is installed and active

items.what: Email, first and last name, phone number, city, state, ZIP code and country from the billing details of a paid event ticket order, tagged with the event, its region and the ticket type
items.where: The FluentCRM contact list in this website's database
items.when: only when FluentCRM is installed and active and tickets are sold through the site's checkout

items.what: Email, first and last name of membership applicants and members, tagged with their membership status and plan
items.where: The FluentCRM contact list in this website's database
items.when: only when FluentCRM is installed and active

notes: New people are added as transactional contacts, for receipts and event notes only; they get marketing emails only if they subscribe themselves. Staff can also bring in everyone from before the sync was switched on. Nothing here is sent outside this website.
